checks.label: NFC Enabled
checks.remediation: Disable NFC in Settings > Connected devices > Connection preferences > NFC when not in use.

checks.label: Android Beam
checks.description: Android Beam can be used for data exfiltration
checks.remediation: Disable Android Beam via Settings > Connected devices > Connection preferences > NFC > Android Beam.

checks.label: NFC Payment Default
checks.remediation: Review the default NFC payment app in Settings > Apps > Default apps > Tap and pay.

checks.label: Tap and Pay
checks.remediation: Disable tap-and-pay in Settings > Apps > Default apps > Tap and pay if contactless payments are not needed.

checks.label: NFC Service Detailed Status
checks.description: NFC service internal state - mState/push/screen details for security posture analysis
checks.remediation: If NDEF push is enabled, disable it to prevent unauthorized data sharing over NFC.

checks.label: NFC Reader Mode Active
checks.description: NFC reader mode parameters active - may indicate relay attack preparation or unauthorized card reading
checks.remediation: Identify and close the app holding NFC reader mode. Revoke NFC permissions for untrusted apps.

checks.label: Secure Element (eSE/UICC) Status
checks.description: Secure element status - eSE/UICC stores payment credentials, HCE indicates host card emulation
checks.remediation: Verify only trusted apps use HCE. Remove unknown NFC payment apps from Settings > Apps.
